description: IQM Pixel conversion scripts on pxl.iqm.com/i/pixel/{uuid} and pxl.stage.iqm.com/i/pixel/{uuid}. IQM documents that generated snippet. Postback conversions are not contracted.

params.name: conversion_id
params.description: IQM calls this a UUID and shows a canonical UUID in the generated script URL, plus a compact hexadecimal UUID in the API response. Both forms are accepted.
params.fix_hint: Copy the Pixel Script Code from the IQM Conversions app so the path is /i/pixel/{uuid}.
